title: Best tool to track my activities
body: I’ve been using the app for over two years now to track my activities and it works perfectly for me. Even though I have a smart watch it doesn’t provide such reporting as this app. Fun, simple, functional.

title: Update required renewed payment. Scammed out of current subscription.
body:
The app suddenly stopped working after 2 years of tracking and wouldnt open. 
Lodged a support ticket- no answer. There were no updates available. 
Deleted the app and reinstalled it - all data was lost, no record of previous purchase and it’s asking me to purchase again.

Very disappointing.
